detail.reason: GEODATA is a sparse product within these W10 cells: pure-positive pixels (fraction >= 0.90) occur in 3 cells in 2015 and 3 cells in 2020 (2 in both); no spatial train/val/test binary split meets the frozen minimums. No C1 training is run; the EO/label support ledger is retained for evidence.

agreement_evaluations.label: GEODATA_2020
agreement_evaluations.cells: positive test cells where GEODATA maps

C5_modality_ablation.identity_requirements: identical cell roles, patch geometry, seeds, budget; per-arm train-only normalization

rf_pixel.features: EO bands + NDVI; S1 arm adds VV, VH and VV-VH log-ratio

protocol_items_1_to_17.1_eligible_sets: C1 GEODATA 2015->2020 / Landsat 8: 14 EO-eligible cells but only 3 GEODATA pure-positive cells per year (2 in both) -> INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT, no split, no training. C2 CMSA 2020->2021 / Sentinel-2: 18 EO-eligible cells, of which 5 carry CMSA pure-positive pixels in BOTH years (R00236 Guangdong, R00311/R00334 Zhejiang, R00349 Jiangsu, R00413 Shandong) -> SUPPORTED on SPLIT-S2. C4 reuses C2 trained models for cross-source agreement; C5 restricts SPLIT-S2 roles to the 17 cells with a landed S1-A 2020 product (all 5 positive cells qualify). C3: all provinces INSUFFICIENT, see task verdicts. Missing/zero-support cells are reported, never substituted.
protocol_items_1_to_17.2_cell_grouping: The W10 Albers 10 km cell is the only split unit. Patches, scenes, dates, modalities and years of one cell inherit the cell's single role; patches are never split across roles.
protocol_items_1_to_17.3_region_grouping: Province (frozen region_province) is the cross-region unit. The CMSA positive core covers 4 provinces with at most 2 positive cells each (Zhejiang), and total C2 cells per province are below the >=4/remaining >=8 rule except Fujian (4, 0 positive) and Shandong (4, 1 positive); every province is frozen INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT_FOR_REGION_<name> for C3, no run.
protocol_items_1_to_17.4_train_val_test: SPLIT-S2 (18 cells): 11 train (2 positive + 9 background), 3 val (1 positive + 2 background), 4 test (2 positive + 2 background); 2 witness cells (1 positive, 1 background from a different province). Roles are the first admissible combination in the deterministic SHA-256 scan; exact lists in splits_v0_1.json. No C1 split exists.
protocol_items_1_to_17.5_leakage_buffer: Cross-role cell AABBs in China Albers metres must be >= 250 m apart, verified with spartina.evaluation.splits.find_cross_split_overlaps; temporal grouping holds because each cell has one role. Min cross-role gap and zero-violation requirement are recorded per split.

6_seeds.scope: weight init, patch order, RF subsampling and geometric augmentation draws. The cell split is frozen ONCE (deterministic SHA-256 scan) and is never reseeded.

7_normalization.rule: per-band p005/p995 clip bounds and mean/std from VALID pixels of TRAIN-role cells ONLY, separately per arm (S2, S2+S1); val/test/witness never contribute; post-clip NaN/non-finite -> 0.0; statistics persisted with every run

8_patch_extraction.rule: patches drawn only AFTER cell roles are frozen; half the training patches contain >=1 SOURCE_MAPPED_POSITIVE pixel, half are random valid windows; deterministic 6-way flips/rotations per seed; full-cell tiled inference on the 30 m grid; padded border predictions ignored; no 30 m->10 m upsampling anywhere
8_patch_extraction.10m_to_30m: native 10 m S1/S2 EO is averaged (rasterio average resampling) to the 30 m label grid; an aggregated 30 m pixel is valid only when >= 5 of 9 constituent 10 m pixels are valid, else NaN, applied per band

terms.SOURCE_BACKGROUND_WEAK: valid EO pixels with mapped fraction 0 outside gridcode-0/outside-source-window regions; GEODATA in-window mapped background
terms.MIXED: 0.10 < fraction < 0.90 (GEODATA) or 0 < fraction < 0.90 (CMSA/CM-SSM); excluded from binary training and primary binary metrics; reported separately and used by the continuous fraction agreement view
terms.UNKNOWN_IGNORE: NaN/outside-source-window, CMSA gridcode 0 (UNKNOWN_GRIDCODE_ZERO_TODO_VERIFY), invalid EO; ignored in every loss and metric

9_mixed_unknown_handling.note: SILVER background is never a verified ecological negative; source-background agreement is never reported as ecological specificity

protocol_items_1_to_17.10_model_selection_data: All hyperparameters are fixed here (no open-ended HPO). Pos-weight derives from TRAIN valid pixels only (cap 20). Decision threshold: VALIDATION only (grid 0.05-0.95 step 0.01, max validation IoU, ties toward 0.5); threshold 0.5 also reported. TEST and witness never influence sampling, normalization, class weighting, thresholds, early stopping, architecture or source choice.

11_early_stopping.schedule: AdamW; cosine LR; 3 warm-up epochs; batch 16; AMP; max epochs per model in model_configs; early stopping reads validation only

protocol_items_1_to_17.12_held_out_eval_sets: C2 test cells evaluated after the run is frozen: 2020 (reference) and 2021 (cross-year shift). Positive and background-only test cells are reported as separate strata; patch counts AND independent held-out CELL counts are both reported. C4 adds cross-source agreement rows on the same cells. C5 reports paired-arm differences on identical cells/patches/seeds.
protocol_items_1_to_17.13_witness_2020: Two named witness_2020 cells (splits_v0_1.json): one CMSA-positive test cell and one background-only test cell from another province; excluded from every selection/tuning path. CM-SSM is evaluated on witness/TEST cells as external reference only and is never trained, validated, thresholded or tuned against.

14_modality_pairing.rule: season-matched S2/S1 acquisitions within 30 days in the autumn DOY 260-320 window; per-cell date gaps are ledgered (Phase A) and carried in run metadata; observations are NEVER described as simultaneous
14_modality_pairing.near_date_sensitivity: the <= 7-day subset among the 17 C5 cells (5 cells) is descriptive-only and marked INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT for its own split
14_modality_pairing.arms: optical = S2 B2/B3/B4/B8 (4 ch); optical_sar = S2 + VV/VH (6 ch); identical cells, patch geometry, seeds and compute budget; independent train-only normalization per arm

15_metrics: positive-stratum vs background-only-cell stratum; pure-positive vs MIXED reported separately
continuous fraction agreement (probability vs source fraction on non-unknown pixels)
all cross-source numbers are AGREEMENT/reproduction, never accuracy; GOLD = 0

16_uncertainty.primary: per-cell metric values on independent held-out cells; with only 2 positive test cells no inferential cell-level interval is claimed: individual cell values and their range are reported
16_uncertainty.secondary_descriptive: 1000 m spatial block resampling (1000 replicates, 95% percentile) pooled over positive held-out cells, explicitly labelled descriptive; pixel bootstrap is forbidden
16_uncertainty.reporting: mean across seeds 17/42/2026 with all per-seed values

17_compute_budget.gpus: at most 3x RTX 3090; nvidia-smi before each launch
17_compute_budget.rf: CPU; pixel cap per train cell persisted
